decision: Do not adopt cached Q8 invocation reuse on this evidence. Two of three real-model end-to-end comparisons are slower; no repeatable speed benefit or no-regression result. Identical baseline executions also change substantially over the session, so code causality is unresolved. Preserve all data and the candidate; leave production on the existing refined Q4 baseline.

identities.provenance: Previously built CLI executables reused unchanged; hashes checked at start. Source identities are from the prior build records and retained patch, not inferred from today's working tree. No build or patch application in this round.

model.architecture: Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct,28 layers, hidden3072, intermediate8192,24 attention heads,8 KV heads, vocabulary128256, BF16 source weights
model.asset_check: SHA-256 of all six JSON files and both safetensors shards, measured before and after timing. Manifests compare byte-identical. The summary hashes the manifest; full per-asset SHA-256 values are retained in both manifests.
model.settings: generate -hf-model /Users/ryohiga/SpiralReality/models/Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct -weight-format FORMAT -weight-mib 14000 -prompt 'Write a detailed history of the city of Tokyo.' -max-tokens 128 -temperature 0 -threads 4; FORMAT=q8 or q4; unprovided flags retain the frozen CLI defaults.
model.token_scope: Maximum128 generated tokens, not an independently verified actual token count. Plain CLI stdout was captured, not structured token IDs. No tokens-per-second metric is inferred.

measurement.platform: Apple M4, darwin/arm64; saved binaries built with Go1.27.3
measurement.method: /usr/bin/time -lp BINARY generate ARGS, fresh process per leg; stdout saved separately, stderr and OS timing/resource statistics retained together in each .time file.
measurement.scope: Whole CLI process: startup, model loading, resident-weight quantization, prompt handling, prefill, generation, output and exit. Not isolated decode or persistent loaded-model serving latency.
measurement.order: One Q8 baseline/baseline pre-control pair; three Q8 baseline/candidate pairs with orders before-after, after-before, before-after; two Q4 baseline/candidate pairs with orders before-after, after-before; one Q8 baseline/baseline post-control pair.14 executions, one at a time. Timestamped start/end order retained.
measurement.conditions: No simultaneous owned builds, tests, profiling or other model jobs during timing. Default process scheduling, no taskpolicy wrapper or core pinning. Other host activity, memory pressure, thermal/power state and core residency were not controlled. Cache not flushed; hashing source assets before measurement warms filesystem caches, and cache residency may change between processes.
measurement.precision: POSIX real/user/sys seconds printed to two decimals by time. Raw OS process counters and memory statistics retained but not attributed to the Q8 kernel.
measurement.ratios: After-label wall time divided by before-label wall time within each listed pair; candidate/baseline for comparison pairs and baseline/baseline for controls. Independent executions, not matched requests or statistical equivalence tests.

q8_comparisons.interpretation: Two materially unfavorable comparisons and one equal at printed precision. The observed median is about23% slower but is not a causal estimate of the code change; the session also exhibits substantial baseline variation. Neither discard the unfavorable legs nor use the third leg alone to approve adoption.

q4_comparisons.interpretation: Opposite-sign, large changes; the median of two ratios conceals variation and is not evidence of neutrality or acceleration. Q4 arithmetic is unchanged, but the candidate's larger shared descriptor changes its call-state footprint, so this is not a strict same-code control.

strict_controls.interpretation: All four executions use exactly the baseline binary and Q8 settings. Absolute baseline times rise from approximately53 seconds to122-131 seconds across the session. The3.1% and-7.1% within-control differences do not bound variation during other pairs. The reason for drift is not established: no claim that thermal effects, scheduler placement, memory pressure, model loading or the candidate alone explains it.

output_validation.check: Every new complete stdout was cmp-checked immediately against the corresponding preserved refined-Q4-baseline output. The summary independently compares all stdout bytes again and hashes each file. Q8 and Q4 are compared only within format; no across-format output equality claimed.
output_validation.availability: Raw stdout, model files and executables remain local ignored artifacts; external independent validation requires those artifacts. Timing/resource logs, asset manifests, hashes and the timestamp ledger are retained under validation/performance.

memory_and_counters.interpretation: Raw maximum resident size, peak footprint, CPU times, instructions retired and cycles elapsed describe complete OS processes, including model conversion/loading. They are not Go allocation counts, decode-only counters, hardware-independent instruction counts or proof about one stack reload. No real-model allocation savings or RSS reduction is established here.
memory_and_counters.prior_allocation_evidence: Synthetic warm-kernel and whole-generation allocation evidence remains in prior records. The candidate executor's120-to160-byte fixed-size tradeoff also remains; this measurement does not override either.

verification.summary_script: scripts/summarize_q8_realmodel.py validates frozen binary hashes, required nonnegative CPU/positive wall/RSS fields, rejects duplicate timing fields, checks every stdout against its within-format reference and requires all14 completed ledger entries. All pair samples and raw hashes are retained.
verification.python: python3 -m pytest scripts -q:61 tests and480 subtests passed, including four new time-parser/pair-preservation tests.
verification.production: No production runtime or Go test changes, no fresh Go test/build, no commit/push/PR. Current runtime remains the prior refined Q4 source.

next_gate: Any adoption proposal still needs repeatable real-model no-regression evidence under sufficiently stable execution conditions. If the next investigation isolates loaded-model generation from loading/quantization, treat that as a different protocol with separately built and identified harnesses; do not mix its timing with this whole-CLI record.
